description.en: Handcrafted Tailwind CSS marketing sections and blocks for SaaS landing pages.
description.zh: 手工打磨的高品质 Tailwind CSS 营销区块，专为现代 SaaS 落地页而生。

content.en: Tailark is an extensive library of handcrafted, responsive marketing blocks and sections built on pure Tailwind CSS. Covering landing heroes, feature showcases, customer testimonials, and conversion-focused CTAs, Tailark enables developers to ship modern commercial websites swiftly.
content.zh: Tailark 是一套精心雕琢的高品质 Tailwind CSS 商业建站区块库。专注于 SaaS 产品营销主页与企业品牌站搭建，收录数十款经过严苛响应式调校的 Hero 区块、特性罗列矩阵与客户见证墙，代码纯粹易读，可直接集成进 Astro、Next.js 等框架。
